title: A Survey on Stereotype Detection in Natural Language Processing

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review of NLP datasets (e.g., BUG, HONEST), evaluation benchmarks, and mitigation strategies, noting the prevailing limitation of binary gender representation.
Literature review analyzing datasets (e.g., MRHC, DETESTS-Dis) and computational methods for identifying racial stereotypes, explicit/implicit biases, and intersectional fairness.
Literature review of computational analyses and datasets (e.g., Queereotypes) focused on homotransphobia, dehumanizing language, and LGBTQIA+ representation in NLP.
Literature review of taxonomies and multilingual datasets (e.g., StereoImmigrants, FB-Stereotypes) tracking stereotypical portrayals of immigrants in discourse.
Literature review of NLP benchmarks and hate speech datasets (e.g., StereoSet, HaSpeeDe2) that measure stereotypes targeting religious groups such as Muslims.
Literature review of studies measuring and mitigating biases in contextualized word representations and language models regarding professions.
Literature review highlighting age-related stereotypes as an under-researched area, referencing specific studies on extracting these stereotypes from social media.
